name: @vineethnkrishnan/hubspot-mcp

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts from HubSpot CRM with optional property selection and cursor-based pagination. Returns default properties (firstname, lastname, email, phone, company) unless overridden.

properties.description: Properties to include (e.g., ['firstname', 'lastname', 'email']). Uses defaults if not specified.

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the value from paging.next.after in previous response.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Retrieves full details for a specific HubSpot contact including requested properties and optional associations (linked companies, deals, tickets).

contact_id.description: The HubSpot contact ID (numeric string, e.g., '12345').

properties.description: Properties to include. Uses defaults if not specified.

associations.description: Associated object types to include (e.g., ['companies', 'deals']). Returns linked object IDs.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Searches HubSpot contacts using free-text search across default searchable properties (name, email, phone, company). Use for finding contacts by name, email, or company.

properties.description: Properties to include in results. Uses defaults if not specified.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact in HubSpot CRM. Provide at least an email or name. Returns the created contact record with its new ID. The 'properties' field is a key-value map of contact properties (e.g., { email: 'jane@example.com', firstname: 'Jane', lastname: 'Doe', company: 'Acme' }).

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Updates an existing HubSpot contact's properties. Only the provided properties are changed; other properties remain untouched. The 'properties' field is a key-value map of contact properties to update (e.g., { phone: '+1-555-0100', lifecyclestage: 'customer' }).

contact_id.description: The HubSpot contact ID to update (numeric string, e.g., '12345').

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Lists deals from HubSpot CRM with optional property selection and cursor-based pagination. Returns default properties (dealname, amount, dealstage, pipeline, closedate) unless overridden.

properties.description: Properties to include (e.g., ['dealname', 'amount', 'dealstage']). Uses defaults if not specified.

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the value from paging.next.after in previous response.

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Retrieves full details for a specific HubSpot deal including pipeline stage, amount, close date, and optional associations (linked contacts, companies).

deal_id.description: The HubSpot deal ID (numeric string, e.g., '67890').

properties.description: Properties to include. Uses defaults if not specified.

associations.description: Associated object types to include (e.g., ['contacts', 'companies']). Returns linked object IDs.

tools.name: create_deal
tools.description: Creates a new deal in HubSpot CRM. Requires at least a dealname. Returns the created deal record with its new ID. The 'properties' field is a key-value map of deal properties (e.g., { dealname: 'New Contract', amount: '50000', pipeline: 'default', dealstage: 'appointmentscheduled' }).

tools.name: update_deal_stage
tools.description: Updates the stage (and optionally the pipeline) of an existing HubSpot deal. Use this to move a deal through its sales pipeline.

deal_id.description: The HubSpot deal ID to update (numeric string, e.g., '67890').

pipeline.description: The pipeline identifier. Only needed when moving a deal to a different pipeline.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Creates a note in HubSpot and optionally associates it with a contact and/or deal. Use for logging call summaries, meeting notes, or follow-up reminders.

contact_id.description: Contact ID to associate the note with.

deal_id.description: Deal ID to associate the note with.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Lists companies from HubSpot CRM with optional property selection and cursor-based pagination. Returns default properties (name, domain, industry, city, state, phone) unless overridden.

properties.description: Properties to include (e.g., ['name', 'domain', 'industry']). Uses defaults if not specified.

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the value from paging.next.after in previous response.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Retrieves full details for a specific HubSpot company including domain, industry, and optional associations (linked contacts, deals).

company_id.description: The HubSpot company ID (numeric string, e.g., '11111').

properties.description: Properties to include. Uses defaults if not specified.

associations.description: Associated object types to include (e.g., ['contacts', 'deals']). Returns linked object IDs.
